description: This Java source file defines the 'HiveMqtt5ClientActor' class, which manages MQTT 5 protocol communication using Akka actors. It includes factory methods for actor creation, methods for connecting and disconnecting MQTT clients, and for starting publisher and consumer actor instances. The class extends an abstract MQTT client actor, providing specific implementations for MQTT v5.
